name: Mads Christensen
bio:
Mads Christensen's journey into motorsport finance began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in economics from Aarhus University, he initially worked in corporate banking. However, a chance encounter with a former racing driver sparked his interest in the financial intricacies of racing teams. He transitioned into motorsport finance, quickly establishing himself as a meticulous and reliable controller. 

Mads is known for his methodical approach to financial management. He believes in thorough analysis and careful planning, ensuring the team's financial stability. His loyalty to Rahal Letterman Lanigan is unwavering, and he takes pride in contributing to their success. He is not afraid to make difficult decisions and is respected for his honesty and integrity.

His meticulous nature and dedication to detail means he is a very dependable member of the team. While he doesn't court the spotlight, he is a quiet force ensuring the organization is financially secure and compliant.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed hair with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Mads is a man of average height, with a sturdy build and a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always has a cup of black coffee on his desk.
Organizes his financial spreadsheets in a very specific, self-created format.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when concentrating.
